name: Mixed credit and public securities operational status set
purpose: Operational-instance seed data for checking whether portfolio, Security Master, direct-lending, fixed-income, equity, credit-facility, accounting, reconciliation, and reporting functionality is present.
assumptions: The 50 personal loans are individual DirectLoan Security Master entries, not a pool.
Borrowers are synthetic fixture parties so tests can exercise operational relationships without carrying borrower PII.
The undrawn line of credit uses a 250000 commitment amount because the request did not specify the commitment size.
Mortgage packs are represented as mortgage-backed security records with retained servicer, trustee, factor, and valuation evidence requirements.

dataQualityControls.description: Every operational position resolves to a Security Master entry.
Every Security Master entry has an operational ledger account code.
Public securities have price evidence; direct loans are valued through servicing balances.
Late personal loans are expected fixture exceptions for servicing workflow tests.

workflows.summary: Security Master contains all 60 instrument records and needs evidence review for private and structured credit.
52 direct-lending contracts require servicing, accrual, and cash application coverage.
60 positions are linked to accounts, portfolio, ledger book, and Security Master records.
Report pack must include loan tape, commitment schedule, fixed-income holdings, INDI lot, and reconciliation evidence.

capabilityExpectations.description: Each personal loan is registered as its own DirectLoan Security Master entry.
Create, service, accrue, reconcile, and report individual personal loans and standalone loans.
Represent mortgage-backed packs with factor, servicer/trustee, paydown, valuation, and evidence support.
Represent Treasury and corporate bonds with accrued interest, maturity cash flows, price evidence, and credit evidence where applicable.
Represent INDI equity shares with quote, tax-lot, PnL, and corporate-action support.
Track an undrawn line of credit as a commitment with zero drawn principal and full unfunded availability.
Store the scenario as a Meridian operational instance with fund structure, parties, accounts, positions, loans, ledger mapping, workflows, and evidence records.
Exercise servicing calendars, settlement instructions, risk limits, compliance checks, exception queues, data-quality controls, and audit trail review.
Import provider-style source payload files for servicer loans, custodian holdings, broker positions, pricing, bank activity, and lifecycle events.
Apply corporate-action, issuer-event, factor-update, rating-change, loan-delinquency, payment, and commitment-fee events into portfolio and accounting workflows.
Exercise allow and deny decisions for data operator, controller, portfolio manager, report approver, and auditor personas.
